latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Patch Maker Video — Product Showcase and Custom Order Videos for Embroidered Patch Makers and Badge Suppliers.

- Provides video assistance tailored for custom patch makers, showcasing production quality and craftsmanship.
- Supports creation of process clips (e.g., embroidery steps, design-to-product demos) to demonstrate accuracy and technical expertise.
- Helps patch businesses highlight capabilities for various patch types: embroidered, woven, PVC, iron-on, velcro, chenille, bullion, and custom insignia.
- Includes video scripts and guides for showcasing previous projects, customer applications, and order processes to build trust and drive new orders.
- Designed to help patch makers stand out against generic factory offerings by communicating authenticity and technical skill.
